caption: The drawing depicts a single object, which is a band-shaped item resembling a collar or armband, positioned horizontally against a plain, light-colored background. The main portion of the band is a muted purple, with a smooth texture and subtle shading that gives it a three-dimensional appearance. The inner part of the band is a lighter, beige or cream color. On the left end of the band, there is a rectangular section in the same beige or cream color, featuring a blue circular button or fastener in its center. The background is mostly blank, with small textured or patterned swatches attached at the bottom left and right edges of the image. The object is centered in the composition and occupies the majority of the central space.
title: Shaker Man's Collar
